The management is terrible. My son just started orthodontic treatment here and has only had two sessions. Normally, the orthodontist comes in once a week. Today, a brace on his molar came off. I called the clinic to ask what to do and whether we had to wait to see the regular orthodontist, as they had an appointment in two weeks. The staff said no, we could come in right away. We drove there before noon (it's not a short distance). Upon arrival, the staff said we had to wait to see the regular orthodontist because other orthodontists couldn't fix it; they could only give advice. Finally, they said another orthodontist, a friend of the regular orthodontist, could look at it, but they were fully booked for tomorrow at 7 am. All other appointments were full, and the next one would still be almost two weeks away – a day before the regular orthodontist's appointment. They then suggested a general practitioner could remove the brace and keep it until the next appointment in two weeks.

My question is, is this how you manage emergency cases? Couldn't another orthodontist take a look for 5 or 10 minutes and suggest what to do first? I was talking to someone at noon. The clinic closes at 7 PM. I didn't ask to cut in line or anything like that, even though you yourself said that people could come in anytime. Yet, you managed things this way. All of this was done by three staff members at the counter, talking amongst themselves, consulting with each other, and making decisions on their own. I'm not referring to the doctor specifically, and I just want the clinic owner to be aware of this problem.

A dentist friend recommended Teeth Time BKK to me because I had been dealing with a chronic dental issue. I had already received treatment elsewhere, but unfortunately the problem never completely went away. My friend suggested that I see Dr. Duang, and I’m very glad I did.

Dr. Duang was excellent. He took the time to examine my case carefully and explained everything in great detail from what might be causing the problem to the different treatment options available. His explanations were clear and easy to understand, and you can really tell that he is very experienced, especially with more complicated cases. I never felt rushed at any point.

I also had a CT scan done here. The clinic has comprehensive and modern equipment, the whole process was quick and efficient, and the price was very reasonable. I really appreciated being able to have the examination, scan, and consultation handled smoothly in one place.

The entire team deserves a compliment as well. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and attentive. Their teamwork is noticeable, especially in how well they manage appointments and coordinate everything. Even though there were several steps involved in my visit, everything moved quickly and I didn’t have to wait unnecessarily.

One small detail that impressed me more than I expected: this is the first dental clinic I’ve visited where they simply used my Thai ID card to register and create my patient record. No sitting around filling out the same information on multiple forms. This is exactly how it should be in 2026! 😂 It’s a small thing, but it immediately made the whole experience feel modern and well organized.

As for the clinic itself, it’s extremely clean, professional, and well equipped. Everything feels organized and properly maintained, which gives you confidence when you’re undergoing treatment.

Overall, I’m extremely impressed—from Dr. Duang and the dental team to the staff, equipment, and overall system. For someone like me who has been dealing with a persistent problem even after previous treatment elsewhere, finally meeting a dentist who carefully investigates the issue and clearly explains what is happening makes a huge difference.

Easily one of the best dental clinic experiences I’ve ever had. Highly recommended, especially if you have a complicated or persistent dental problem and want a dentist who takes the time to properly investigate and explain your case.
